programs.title: Inside Dubai: Playground of the Rich
programs.desc: The luxurious life of millionaires and billionaires living in the tax haven of the United Arab Emirates.The creators of the documentary also present profiles of people who serve as their servants.

programs.title: Embarrassing Bodies
programs.desc: Dr. Christian Jessen and his team of doctors help people suffering from rare and very embarrassing diseases.In this series, medics will face really difficult challenges.

programs.title: Skin A\u0026E
programs.desc: The fifth installment of the program revealing the stories of people struggling with various skin diseases.A team of dermatologists will try to help patients tired of unsuccessfully fighting diseases.

programs.title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses
programs.desc: Real estate agents accompanied by cameras show clients around the most expensive and amazing properties.Buyers have unlimited funds and are very demanding.

programs.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programs.desc: Tailoring enthusiasts compete in the program, undertaking difficult tasks that test their skills, creativity and work under pressure.They are competing for the title of best non-professional tailor in the UK.

programs.title: The Great British Bake Off
programs.desc: Another installment of the extremely popular show in which twelve confectioners with no professional experience compete for the title of the best.Every week, the competitors receive difficult tasks to verify their talent and culinary skills.Their struggles are assessed by the famous baker Paul Hollywood and the restaurateur Prue Leith, both of whom are very demanding and critical.Each task is time-limited.Time pressure is difficult to bear.The weakest competitors will quickly lose their chance to win the title of best confectioner.The show is hosted by Noeal Fielding and Sandi Toksvig.
